name: Qoder
short: Agentic coding IDE with credit-metered chat, agent and Quest runs across premium models, plus bring-your-own-key on the free tier.

plans.name: Community Edition
plans.notes: 2-week Pro trial with 300 credits; limited completions and next edits; bring your own API key.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 2,000 credits/month; first purchase adds 2,000 bonus credits, renewals add 1,000; Quest, Repo Wiki and Knowledge Card.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.notes: 6,000 credits/month; first purchase adds 6,000 bonus credits; priority access to upcoming features.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: 20,000 credits/month; early access to new features; renewals add 1,000 bonus credits.

plans.name: Credit Pack
plans.notes: One-time, stackable top-up for paid plans; valid 1 month from purchase and non-refundable.
